about_the_game:
The Little Shelter

The Little Shelter is a narrative-driven 2D platformer that follows Lunaaa, a young Asian woman navigating the overwhelming chaos of New York City in search of solace and self-discovery. Caught between reality and surreal dreamscapes, players will embark on a deeply emotional journey through loss, resilience, and transformation.

Key Features:

  • 🎭 Deeply Personal Story – Experience Lunaaa’s emotional struggles, shaped by the highs and lows of city life, as she seeks a place to call home.

  • 🏙️ Surreal NYC-Inspired Environments – Journey through handcrafted 2D levels that blend gritty urban realism with dreamlike visuals, mirroring Lunaaa’s shifting emotional states.

  • 🎮 Platforming & Puzzle Mechanics – Navigate challenging platforming sequences and environmental puzzles that reflect both external obstacles and internal struggles.

  • 🔥 Anxiety System – A unique game mechanic that represents Lunaaa’s emotional state, affecting her movement, perception, and interactions with the world.

  • 🎶 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A rich, immersive score that evolves with the narrative, heightening the emotional depth of Lunaaa’s journey.

  • 🎨 Hand-Drawn Art & Animation – Vibrant, expressive visuals that bring the world to life, blending modern indie aesthetics with evocative storytelling.

Whether you’ve ever felt lost in a city’s noise or found shelter in your own silence, The Little Shelter invites you into a tender, visually stunning meditation on identity, emotion, and the courage to keep moving.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: The game is optimized for 1080p resolution at 30 FPS
